title: Compliance Manager
description:
Crossroads Staffing is seeking a Compliance Manager for a short-term assignment (2–3 months) with a strong possibility of transitioning into a permanent position within different roles in the company in Oro-Medonte. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has strong organizational skills, and is passionate about maintaining high standards of compliance and service.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor incoming claims during work hours
  • Distribute Emergency and General Assignments via Xactimate to Project Managers
  • Manage incoming work from various channels and assign accordingly
  • Set up new assignments in internal systems
  • Ensure adherence to insurance program guidelines (timelines, OH&P, line items, etc.)
  • Maintain accurate and timely updates in all systems
  • Track job start and completion dates
  • Ensure emergency assignments meet 12- or 24-hour reporting requirements
  • Review and upload estimates within required timelines
  • Handle email notifications from Adjusters and forward to Project Managers
  • Communicate with Adjusters and internal teams regarding assignments
  • Oversee program compliance and communicate updates to the team
  • Generate activity and action item reports
  • Ensure all required documentation is signed and properly filed
  • Maintain professional conduct in all client-facing interactions
  • Build positive relationships with clients, insurance partners, and vendors
  • Deliver exceptional service that exceeds expectations
  • Follow company safety and workplace policies
  • Provide coverage for other administrative roles as needed

Qualifications:

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Proficient in computer systems and quick to learn new software
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a dynamic environment
  • Strong customer service and follow-up skills
This is a temporary opportunity with the potential to become a permanent position based on performance and business needs. If you're looking to make an impact and grow within a supportive team, we encourage you to apply!

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Compensation: Bi-weekly pay; overtime after 44 hours

Any information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

title: Staffing Coordinator
description:
🌟 Join Our Team as a Staffing Coordinator – Orillia, ON 🌟

Job Type: Full-Time | In Office Role
Compensation: Base wage + Commission | Health Spending Account | Paid Parking | Mileage Reimbursement

About the Role

As a Staffing Coordinator, you’ll manage a 360° desk—balancing both business development and recruitment. You’ll play a pivotal role in growing our client base across Simcoe Muskoka while sourcing and placing top-tier candidates in both permanent and contract roles.

What You’ll Do

Business Development
- Drive new client acquisition and expand existing accounts
- Conduct on-site business tours to assess staffing needs
- Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and decision-makers

Recruitment
- Source, screen, and interview top talent using modern tools and platforms
- Guide candidates through the hiring process, from prep to placement
- Maintain a strong talent pipeline for rapid response to client needs

Client & Candidate Management
- Act as the main point of contact throughout the recruitment lifecycle
- Schedule interviews, coordinate onboarding, and follow up post-placement
- Keep detailed records in our ATS/CRM systems

What You Bring

- Proven experience in a 360° recruitment role (agency or HR experience is a plus!)
- Strong communication, relationship-building, and organizational skills
- A self-starter mindset with a drive to exceed targets
- Familiarity with ATS/CRM systems
- Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation

Hours & Perks

- Monday–Thursday: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM
- Friday: 8:30 AM – 3:00 PM
- Paid lunch hour (12:30 PM – 1:30 PM)
- Health Spending Account after 6 months
- Municipal parking pass provided
- Mileage reimbursement for client visits

Ready to make an impact?
Apply today and help shape the future of staffing in Simcoe Muskoka with Crossroads Staffing.

Any information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

title: Manufacturing Labourer - Afternoon Shift
description:
Join Our Team in Orillia - Afternoon Shift Opportunities Available!

We are excited to offer full-time positions for Manufacturing team members with one of our esteemed local clients in the beautiful Orillia area. Enjoy the convenience of an afternoon shift, working from Monday to Friday, 3 pm to 11 pm. This role not only provides a steady work schedule but also offers a range of benefits.

Why Choose This Position?

  • No early mornings! Enjoy your coffee
  • Full-time hours with one consistent shift
  • Receive a $1.50/hr shift premium
  • Weekly pay, with overtime after 44 hours
  • Comprehensive training provided

Your Responsibilities Will Include:

  • Working on an assembly line across various departments
  • Manufacturing parts, cables, and elements
  • Operating large machinery to stretch and lengthen metal pieces into cables
  • Winding finished cables on large machines
  • Transporting products to carts
  • Conducting testing and quality control
  • Maintaining production timelines
  • Producing products according to set specifications
  • Keeping your work area clean and organized
  • Adhering to workplace health and safety guidelines

What We Are Looking For:

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs, and perform standing, bending, and twisting tasks
  • Experience using micrometers
  • Strong reliability and good attendance record
  • Ability to follow directions and a strong willingness to learn
  • Proficiency in reading a tape measure
  • Previous manufacturing experience is an asset
  • Availability to train on the day shift (Mon-Fri, 7 am to 3 pm) for a minimum of 1 week
  • Must have CSA approved steel-toed boots for start date

We offer a competitive wage of $19.00/hr plus a $1.50/hr shift premium for all hours worked on the afternoon shift.

We are committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise Human Resources of any accommodations needed to ensure you have access to a fair and equitable process. Any information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.
